# `smelt.paint`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

**Advanced:** Low-level building block for plugins that need full control. It may change more freely than the rest of the API.

Register Lua callbacks against custom paint regions. UiHost-only.

## `smelt.paint.frame`

```lua
fun(func: fun(arg1: smelt.paint.Slice, arg2: smelt.paint.Ctx), opts: smelt.paint.FrameOpts?): smelt.paint.Effect
```

Types: [`smelt.paint.Slice`](types.md#smeltpaintslice), [`smelt.paint.Ctx`](types.md#smeltpaintctx), [`smelt.paint.FrameOpts`](types.md#smeltpaintframeopts), [`smelt.paint.Effect`](types.md#smeltpainteffect)

Register `func(slice, ctx)` over the finished screen and return an `Effect` handle. It can read, recolor or move cells before the frame is sent. `ctx.cursor` follows the caret; opt-in `history` exposes `prev`, `damage` and `scrolls`. An Effect is not a layout leaf. Remove it to stop.

## `smelt.paint.register`

```lua
fun(func: fun(arg1: smelt.paint.Slice, arg2: smelt.paint.Ctx), opts: smelt.paint.Opts?): smelt.paint.Paint
```

Types: [`smelt.paint.Slice`](types.md#smeltpaintslice), [`smelt.paint.Ctx`](types.md#smeltpaintctx), [`smelt.paint.Opts`](types.md#smeltpaintopts), [`smelt.paint.Paint`](types.md#smeltpaintpaint)

Register `func(slice, ctx)` as a paint leaf and return its `Paint` handle. Use the handle anywhere a window id is accepted in the layout / overlay APIs; the callback runs each frame the leaf is visible, in its layer order, so the slice already holds what was painted below it. See `smelt.paint.Ctx` for what `ctx` holds.
